title: Tiny, cute windmill
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#1a1a3a"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#2d2d5e"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- grass ground -->
  <rect x="10" y="78" width="80" height="14" rx="4" fill="#3a7a2a"/>
  <rect x="10" y="82" width="80" height="10" rx="3" fill="#4a9a35"/>
  <!-- windmill body (tower) -->
  <polygon points="42,78 58,78 55,45 45,45" fill="#e8d8b0"/>
  <polygon points="42,78 50,78 50,45 45,45" fill="#f5ecc8"/>
  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points="43,45 57,45 50,32" fill="#c05030"/>
  <polygon points="43,45 50,45 50,32" fill="#e06040"/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x="47" y="64" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#8a5a2a"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="69" r="0.8" fill="#f5ecc8"/>
  <!-- window -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="54" r="3" fill="#7ac0e8"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="54" r="2" fill="#a0e0ff"/>
  <!-- windmill blades hub -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="4" fill="#d0a050"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="3" fill="#f0c060"/>
  <!-- blades -->
  <g fill="#f0e8d0" stroke="#d0c0a0" stroke-width="0.5">
    <polygon points="50,38 46,20 50,18 54,20" fill="#f0e8d0"/>
    <polygon points="54,42 72,38 74,42 72,46" fill="#e8e0c8"/>
    <polygon points="50,46 54,64 50,66 46,64" fill="#e0d8c0"/>
    <polygon points="46,42 28,46 26,42 28,38" fill="#e8e0c8"/>
  </g>
  <!-- blade highlights -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5">
    <polygon points="50,38 48,24 50,22 52,24"/>
    <polygon points="54,42 68,39 69,42 68,44"/>
  </g>
  <!-- small flower left -->
  <circle cx="25" cy="80" r="2" fill="#ff6080"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="80" r="1" fill="#ffe060"/>
  <!-- small flower right -->
  <circle cx="75" cy="81" r="2" fill="#ff80a0"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="81" r="1" fill="#ffe060"/>
  <!-- tiny cloud -->
  <ellipse cx="25" cy="20" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#4a4a8a" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="18" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#4a4a8a" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
